explanation: A small program on your phone that does one job, like calling or WhatsApp.
pcm: Small program for your phone wey dey do one work.

explanation: Words sent to you on your phone.
pcm: Words wey dem send give you for phone.

explanation: The company that gives your phone signal and internet.
pcm: Company wey dey give your phone signal.

explanation: Internet you buy from your network. It is used when you open websites or WhatsApp.
pcm: Internet wey you buy from network. E dey finish when you open website.

explanation: Phone credit you buy to make calls and send messages.
pcm: Phone credit wey you buy for call.

explanation: Internet from a router. It does not use your airtime.
pcm: Internet from router. E no dey use your airtime.

explanation: To bring something from the internet onto your phone so you can use it later.
pcm: To bring something from internet come your phone.

explanation: A secret word that opens your account. Never share it.
pcm: Secret word wey dey open your account. No share am.

explanation: A secret number, usually four digits, that opens your bank app or card. Never share it.
pcm: Secret number wey dey open your bank app. No share am.

explanation: A one-time code sent to your phone to confirm something. It expires quickly. Never share it.
pcm: One-time code wey dem send your phone. No share am.

explanation: Bank Verification Number. It is private. Never send it to a stranger.
pcm: Bank Verification Number. Na private. No send am to stranger.

explanation: A trick to take your money or your secrets.
pcm: Trick to collect your money or secret.

explanation: Words or a picture you can press to open a page on the internet.
pcm: Word or picture wey you press to open page.

explanation: To stop a person from calling or messaging you.
pcm: To stop person from call or message you.

explanation: A new version of an app that fixes problems and keeps you safe.
pcm: New version of app wey dey fix problem.

explanation: The part of the phone that stores power. Charge it when it is low.
pcm: Part of phone wey dey keep power.

explanation: Point of Sale. A small machine a shop uses to collect card or transfer payments.
pcm: Small machine shop dey use collect money.

explanation: A short code like *123# that works without internet data.
pcm: Short code like *123# wey work without data.

explanation: To send money from one bank account to another.
pcm: To send money from one account go another.

explanation: The amount of money left in your account.
pcm: Money wey remain for your account.

explanation: A message from your bank telling you money went in or out.
pcm: Message from bank say money enter or comot.

explanation: A short spoken message you send in a chat instead of typing.
pcm: Short talk wey you send inside chat instead of type.

explanation: A chat where many people can talk together, like a family group.
pcm: Chat where plenty people dey talk together.

explanation: A saved name and phone number in your phone.
pcm: Name and number wey you save for phone.

explanation: A picture of what is on your phone screen.
pcm: Picture of wetin dey your phone screen.

explanation: The app you use to open websites, often with a globe picture.
pcm: App wey you use open website.

explanation: The place where you change how your phone works, like text size and Wi-Fi.
pcm: Place wey you change how your phone work.

explanation: National Identification Number. Keep it private. Use only official .gov.ng websites.
pcm: National Identification Number. Keep am private.

explanation: Money saved for when you stop work. Use only official pension offices or .gov.ng websites.
pcm: Money wey dem keep for when you stop work.

explanation: A teacher who helps a group of learners.
pcm: Teacher wey dey help group of learners.
